regions.purpose: The full-screen map canvas — a pin for every Collection Entry in every visible Collection. Panning and zooming move the viewport; a long-press drops a pin.
A button in the top-left navigationIcon slot. In browse mode it shows the menu (hamburger) icon and opens the app menu drawer; suppressed in add-to-collection mode (replaced by closeButton).

A button in the top-left navigationIcon slot in add-to-collection mode. Shows the close (X) icon and cancels the add-to-collection flow, dropping the carried Collection and returning to CollectionDetail. Replaces menuButton during the flow.

A search field across the top-center, spanning roughly 30% of the surface width so it never overlaps the navigationIcon. Tapping it widens the field and raises the keyboard; submitting resolves Location candidates. Present in both modes — finding a place is part of completing the add flow.
A panel along the bottom of the surface holding entry to the Collection list. Suppressed in add-to-collection mode (replaced by statusBar in the same slot) so the user cannot start a second flow.

A left-hand drawer, opened from the menuButton — the app menu. Holds a Filter section — a field to search the user's Collections by name and a list of Collections, each toggleable to show or hide its pins — and an entry to Settings. Suppressed in add-to-collection mode (no menuButton to open it).
Occupies the bottom slot of the surface in add-to-collection mode (replacing bottomBar), naming the target Collection — "Adding to {collectionName}".

shows: a pin at the Entry's Location coordinates
the pin colored by its Collection's appearance
visited or unvisited styling from the Entry's Review status

lists.emptyState: Before any Collection has Entries the map shows no pins; the bottomBar still points the user toward creating a Collection.

shows: address or category from the provider, when supplied

lists.emptyState: An empty or unsubmitted search field shows no results; results appear only after the user submits a query — there is no search-ahead. The map stays the focus.

shows: whether its pins are currently shown

affordance.label: Toggle a Collection's pins on the map

lists.emptyState: With no Collections the drawer's Filter section is empty; the user has nothing to toggle yet.
